Unser Unternehmen entwickelt hochmoderne Pumpen, intelligente Mess- und Steuerungssysteme sowie digitale Lösungen, die eine effiziente Wassernutzung ermöglichen.

Mit einem starken globalen Netzwerk und einem klaren Fokus auf Nachhaltigkeit tragen wir dazu bei, Wasserknappheit zu bekämpfen, Infrastruktur zu modernisieren und Gemeinden weltweit mit sauberem Wasser zu versorgen.

At Sunrun, we're on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we're building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. To do it, we're designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. It's why we've become the #1 home solar and battery company in America.

We're unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle - from sale through installation and beyond - so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.

Who We Are We're on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs.

Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses. Overview The Field Sales Consultant self-generates sales leads and presents in-home presentations on our solar products and services for potential customers.

Their priority is to make a genuine human connection with the potential customers with the intent to qualify and vet solar as a viable energy solution for their home and families. If you enjoy face to face interaction, engaging customers and find the idea of working out in the field exciting, then this is the job for you!

Responsibilities/The Impact Develop effective self-generated sales strategies, leads and appointments with potential customers Provide an industry leading customer sales experience from initial contact through installation and after the customer's system is turned on Conduct in-home sales presentations for potential customers and evaluate customers' knowledge and needs, building productive long lasting relationships Handle the pipeline of activity from prospect to install by following up with all leads and in-home consultations Accurately disposition and report on outcomes via our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tool Meet minimum required sales targets as set by sales leadership Qualifications/How You Will Be Successful Minimum of 1 year of sales and/or lead generation experience, with in-home sales experience preferred Must be 21 years of age, possess a valid driver's license, and maintain a clean driving record with the ability to pass a driving background check Excellent communication and teamwork skills needed to partner cross-functionally when addressing customer needs Willingness to spend time traveling within local market, depending on business needs and sales model Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, to accommodate homeowners' schedules Intermediate comfort level with technology, utilizing an IPAD/computer and multiple software applications.

(experience with a CRM is a plus) How you will be Awarded Full benefits package including health, vision, dental insurance, 401K with company match, Employee Stock Purchase Program, paid training, and much more The opportunity to invest in yourself and your career through PowerU - Sunrun's 100% tuition reimbursement program with over 150 educational opportunities A part of the Freedom Time Off (FTO) Plan - Because of the nature of our business, Sunrun cannot guarantee how much time you will be able to take away from work.

Employees on our Freedom Time Off Plan are not limited to a set number of days that they are entitled to take off from work and instead have the freedom to manage how much time off they need!

Highly competitive sales commissions paid biweekly including eligibility for bonus compensation Competitive salary plus lucrative performance incentives through our Nike/Lululemon sponsored incentive program. You'll have the opportunity to earn Nike/Lululemon swag, prizes and amazing trips. Internal advancement opportunities, as earned.

Average compensation in California (Base pay + Incentives) for the first 12 months ranges from $60,000 to $90,000 ( personal success dependent) Recruiter: Todd Cooper (todd.cooper1@sunrun.com) Please note that the compensation information is made in good faith for this position only.

It assumes that the successful candidate will be located in markets within the United States that warrant the compensation. Please speak with your recruiter to learn more. The starting salary/wage for this opportunity is in compliance with the local wage requirements. Compensation decisions will not be based on a candidate's salary history.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability and you need reasonable accommodation during the hiring process or to perform this role, please contact us at candidateaccommodations@sunrun.com . At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce.

As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results.

From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.
We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.
Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes.

Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.
AS A BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE YOU WILL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO:
Drive incremental sales pipeline and support existing customer requests
Work with the NeruaFlash Marketing and sales team to build and execute Campaigns with prospects, aligned to Salesforce and AWS sales motions
Follow up and create relationships with our AWS, Amazon Connect, and Salesforce Partner networks
Work closely with the sales team to manage the life cycle of a client and/or opportunity, and accurately track customer interactions, accounts, contacts, and updates in Salesforce
Use prospecting strategies to lead initial outreach to prospects
Identify the needs and challenges of the prospective customer
Schedule discovery meetings for sales representatives and prospects
Contribute to the ongoing development of the BDR program at NeuraFlash by introducing fresh and innovative ideas for engaging our customers and partners
Support Partner Communications by writing BASHOs and executing follow up on partner marketing emails
Log and track meetings and opportunities generated from BDR follow up in Salesforce
Be an impactful team member of the sales organization

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent relevant experience
Familiarity with Salesforce CRM and AWS
1-3 years of sales, business development, or inside sales experience (preferably in AWS, SaaS, or Salesforce ecosystem)
Hunter mentality and driven to find key stakeholders and new business opportunities
Competitive nature and confident demeanor- we want someone who is not afraid to speak with high level customers!
Passion for contributing to the growth and overall success of the business
Track record of being a high achiever in past organizations (school, past work experience, volunteering, athletics, etc.)
Required to work from our Boston office at least 3x/week

What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?
Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn’t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it’s a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.
Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don’t forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

Location Our Sales Development Representative will be an integral part of our DoiT Cloud Intelligence (DCI) sales team. This role is fully remote. We are hiring for this position across EMEA, specifically in the UK, the Netherlands, Ireland, Belgium and Switzerland.

Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more.

An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The OpportunityAs a Sales Development Representative for DoiT Cloud Intelligence (DCI), you will be responsible for outbound lead generation, including email, calling, and using LinkedIn to book demos with qualified prospects in your region.

You’ll be on the front line of the sales team, collaborating closely with the regional Field Sales teams and progress the qualified pipeline with Account Executives (AE) by focusing on the primary metrics of qualified meetings booked and pipeline generated .

We are looking for an agile, "startup-minded" individual who is ready to learn quickly and evolve as we scale. You will also build internal relationships with our sales, marketing, and cloud vendor teams.

Responsibilities Set meetings via outbound prospecting through both automated and manually-driven campaigns to achieve daily and monthly pipeline targets. Partner closely with Account Executives to ensure tight alignment on territory planning, account prioritization, and feedback loops to maximize pipeline quality.

Help build and refine our outbound motion by identifying and reaching decision-makers. Build, manage, and optimize multi-channel outbound campaigns at scale using various tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Clay, etc.

Own the outbound process end-to-end, from detailed account research to ensuring a qualified meeting is successfully booked for the Account Executive team. Partner with leadership to refine messaging, call scripts, and multi-channel outreach strategies to improve conversion rates and outbound effectiveness.

Support Regional GTM & Marketing activities across digital and onsite formats. Clearly communicate compelling value propositions to technical buyers and stay current with the latest product and service information.

Stay current with the latest offering/product/service information Some travel may be required Qualifications 1–3+ years of SDR/BDR experience in Cloud, preferably with a background in selling to technical decision makers such as CTO, VP Engineering or Head of DevOps. Proven experience selling SaaS B2B or cloud products or services.

Proven history of achieving and reaching for results in an outbound lead generation environment. Experience managing multiple priorities and juggling various tools or campaigns in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Goal-oriented and self-motivated mindset with the "grit" to work through challenges and multiply sales speed.

Ability to exercise a high degree of autonomy and sales authority while remaining highly organized. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and French. Are you a Do’er?Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally. What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge and having fun!

Click here to learn more about our core values . Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page . We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button.

You have real sales skills and know how to close. This is a closing seat, and closing ability is the number one thing.
You have inside sales, phone sales, or SDR experience, with a real track record on the phone.
You handle objections on your own and ask for the sale, without sounding pushy or robotic.
You stay calm under pressure: when a customer pushes back or gets frustrated, you hear them out and respond thoughtfully instead of getting flustered or talking over them.
You communicate in confident, professional English at C2 level with a low accent, and sound natural on the phone.
You respond and follow through without anyone watching.
You keep the CRM clean and never let a follow-up slip.
You are the voice that turns warm customers into booked jobs. The demand is already there: customers call, the field team visits, and revenue gets left on the table when nobody follows up to close. This is not a cold-sales grind. You work from proven scripts, but you make them your own and sound human rather than robotic. You win the deal by handling objections live and guiding customers to yes.

Call customers and close deals, whether the opportunity is a service job or a larger project.
Handle objections live on the call and guide the customer to a yes rather than reading from a script.
Take the company's scripts, learn from them, and make them sound natural, never robotic.
Follow up with customers after each visit, capture honest feedback, and turn warm conversations into booked work.
Update the CRM (ServiceTitan) in real time with accurate records on every contact.

Experience in plumbing or construction, or a track record closing service and installation projects.
Formal sales training or coaching, with frameworks for discovery and closing.
Hands-on experience with ServiceTitan or a similar CRM.
Previous experience in a high-volume, phone-based, customer-facing role.
What success looks like
First 90 days: you are contacting customers and closing deals, ramped on scripts, and maintaining clean CRM hygiene.
Ongoing: you sustain a strong close rate month over month, meet conversion targets, and proactively surface and fix friction in the sales process.

You will get an email from Puente with a short online assessment and a quick grammar check.
You will record three short video answers so we can see how you communicate.
If it looks like a fit, our recruiter sets up an interview.

As a Senior Sales Development Representative (Sr. SDR), you will play a critical role in driving pipeline generation and revenue growth across the EMEA region. Building upon core sales development expertise, you will own strategic prospecting initiatives, develop targeted account penetration strategies, and partner closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to create qualified opportunities within enterprise and mid-market organisations.
You will also serve as a role model and mentor to newer SDRs, sharing best practices and helping elevate overall team performance.

s.h: How you will shape sales development at Achievers
s.t:
Generate qualified sales opportunities through strategic outbound prospecting across assigned EMEA territories.
Conduct research and account mapping to identify key decision-makers, influencers, and buying committees within target organisations.
Build relationships with multiple stakeholders across prospective accounts to increase account penetration and create new business opportunities.
Partner closely with Account Executives to develop account strategies, progress opportunities, and drive pipeline growth.
Create and execute targeted outreach campaigns leveraging phone, email, social selling, and other prospecting channels.
Maintain accurate accounts, opportunities, and activity data within Salesforce and other sales engagement platforms.
Stay informed on EMEA market trends, competitive activity, and industry developments to enhance prospecting effectiveness and account strategies.
Consistently achieve or exceed pipeline generation, meeting creation, and activity targets.
Share best practices and provide guidance to less experienced SDR team members, contributing to overall team success.
Demonstrate a multithreading approach into large key accounts.
Outline using AI to streamline prospecting
Process and create efficiencies in workflow

s.t:
18+ months of experience in a Sales Development Representative (SDR), Business Development Representative (BDR), or similar prospecting role with a track record of achieving or exceeding targets.
Strong understanding of outbound prospecting and lead qualifications.
Proven ability to engage and build relationships with stakeholders at multiple levels within an organisation.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively.
Experience using CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and sales engagement tools such as Outreach, Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar technologies.
Strong organisational, prioritisation, and time management skills.
Results-oriented mindset with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Experience prospecting within the EMEA market and an understanding of regional business practices.
Demonstrated ability to share best practices and positively contribute to team performance and culture.

The Inbound Retail Sales Representative is a consultative sales professional who leverages their skills to offer customers personalized solutions with Blue Stream’s industry-leading products and services.

## Description ##
## Where passion meets opportunity ##
The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!
## Your Purpose ##
MSC Cruises, the world-s third largest cruise line, is expanding its Talent Acquisition function in support of its continued growth in the US market. We are hiring a Talent Acquisition Manager to lead hiring for high-impact, business-critical, and leadership-level roles across the organization.

This role requires deep full-cycle recruiting experience, a strong track record of improving recruiting processes, and a thoughtful, data-driven approach to talent strategy.

This person will serve as a trusted partner to senior leaders and play a key role in attracting and securing exceptional talent for some of the company-s most important hires. **This role is based within commuting distance of downtown Miami and requires 4 days per week in office.**

* Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for critical roles across the business, including high-profile leadership positions.
* Build strong relationships with hiring managers and senior leaders, serving as a trusted Talent Acquisition partner and advisor.
* Partner closely with hiring managers to understand talent needs, shape job descriptions, and develop effective recruiting strategies. Provide data-driven recommendations on how to attract and assess top talent.
* Use recruiting metrics and analytics to track key performance indicators such as time-to-fill, quality of hire, source of hire, and candidate conversion rates.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR leadership to streamline and optimize hiring processes.
* Develop and execute creative sourcing strategies to build strong pipelines of qualified candidates. Leverage a mix of traditional and innovative sourcing channels, including social media, job boards, employee referrals, networking, and direct outreach, while using data to refine strategy and improve results.
* Conduct proactive talent mapping, market research, and competitive benchmarking to inform search strategy and stay ahead of industry trends, compensation benchmarks, and competitor hiring practices.
* Lead in-depth candidate screening and interview processes to assess qualifications, leadership capabilities, and overall fit.
* Leverage data and feedback to optimize candidate engagement, reduce time-to-hire, and enhance the overall candidate experience.
* Lead the offer process by advising hiring managers on compensation, negotiating complex offers with senior candidates, and ensuring a smooth transition from offer acceptance through onboarding.
* Ensure a positive, transparent, and professional experience for candidates throughout the hiring process. Provide timely feedback and keep candidates informed at every stage.
## Your Journey so far ##
* 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting and/or executive recruitment experience, with a strong track record of hiring for complex, business-critical, and leadership-level roles from manager through SVP.
* Significant in-house recruiting experience within a high-growth, large-scale, or fast-paced environment, with proven success leading searches across functions such as sales, marketing, procurement, IT, and other strategic corporate areas.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage recruiting data and analytics to identify trends, generate insights, and improve hiring outcomes. Strong proficiency in Excel and other data analysis tools, with experience using Applicant Tracking Systems and recruitment analytics platforms.
* Deep experience developing targeted sourcing strategies and engaging high-caliber talent through multiple channels, including LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking, and direct outreach.
* Strong interviewing and assessment skills, including experience conducting competency-based, behavioral, and situational interviews to evaluate leadership capability, organizational fit, and long-term potential.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex insights in a clear and actionable manner, influence senior stakeholders, and represent the company credibly with candidates.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple high-priority searches simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and a high bar for candidate quality.
* Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems such as SuccessFactors, Workday, or Greenhouse, as well as recruiting analytics platforms such as LinkedIn Talent Insights, Google Analytics, or similar performance-tracking tools.
## Your Essentials ##
* US Passport or US Permanent Resident
* MSC Cruises is an E-Verify employe
## Our commitment ##
We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.
Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

s.h: We're looking for Business Development Representatives
s.t:
We’re building a new insurance business from the ground up to protect SMEs, and we’re looking for Business Development Representatives to join our team. If you’re a high-energy communicator who loves building relationships and wants to gain experience, qualifications, and career progression at a leading fintech, apply now.
The company
We're here because we believe in SMEs. We believe they deserve better than confusing jargon, slow and outdated customer experiences, and being caught out by hidden conditions and fees. And we believe it's our job to help them navigate risk with confidence.
Since 2012, iwoca has made finance fast, flexible, and fair for over 150,000 businesses. Now, we're doing the same for insurance. We're building a brand new insurance business from the ground up — to protect SMEs in the moments that matter most.
Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed by providing access to better finance and services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team is a small, entrepreneurial group responsible for launching iwoca's new SME insurance business. Here’s how the team work together:
Customer-obsessed: The team challenges itself to build insurance that its customers actually want, rather than what insurers simply want to sell.
Curious & supportive: The team collaborates across disciplines to find creative solutions to complex problems in a safe and supportive environment.
Move fast & have fun: The team is fast-paced and highly autonomous, but makes sure to celebrate wins and have fun along the way.
Ambitious & entrepreneurial: The environment is ideal for people who thrive on taking ownership of their work and are ready to roll up their sleeves and build.

You’ll be the person introducing our new insurance offering to businesses who are tired of the status quo. You’ll help SMEs move away from complicated, slow insurance policies and make them aware of a fairer, more transparent way to protect their business.

Proactively engage with SME business operators by phone ahead of their business insurance renewal date to offer a better alternative.
Master the art of the pitch—navigating gatekeepers, articulating our value proposition, and turning objections into opportunities for our brokers to help them.
Manage your pipeline end-to-end within our HubSpot CRM, ensuring meticulous record-keeping and proactive follow-ups so that no opportunity is missed.
Collaborate closely with our in-house brokers and wider team to turn early customer feedback into insights that refine our product offering and sales strategy.

Previous experience navigating outbound or client-facing interactions within a professional business environment.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to build rapport, influence decisions, and handle commercial objections over the phone and email.
A high-energy, resilient, and results-oriented personality that thrives on achieving goals. You have sharp problem-solving instincts and a "can-do" mindset.
Organised and proactive approach to managing your workload.
Ability to adapt and excel in a fast-moving, high-growth atmosphere.
Eagerness to learn - insurance industry experience isn’t necessary - we will provide training to help you succeed.
A desire to secure professional qualifications and drive long-term career progression within a rapidly scaling fintech environment

We expect to pay around £30,000 plus bonus for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.
The culture
At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the professional development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage you to explore new areas of interest to help us innovate and improve our products and services.
The offices

Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.
Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

Flexible working hours.

25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.
A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.
Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.
3% Pension contributions on total earnings.
An employee equity incentive scheme.
Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.
Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.
Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.
Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal , you will be a key driver of growth within our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical.

In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise provider, payer and life sciences clients by helping them solve complex business challenges across a broad range of capabilities, including technology, marketing, management consulting, and AI-enabled transformation.

You will develop tailored solutions that help clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes.
This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and to establish Toptal as a core services provider embedded in your clients’ critical initiatives.
This is a remote position with concentrated field work across the US. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Healthcare and Life Sciences organizations are transforming due to regulatory changes, and pressure to perform far outpacing their current abilities. AI has shifted from experimentation to execution, and companies across this sector are actively rebuilding how work gets done, across therapeutic development, care delivery and healthcare financing. Toptal ’s Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) vertical already partners with some of the largest organizations in the world on exactly this work.
This role exists to bring expanded coverage to the US, where our client concentration and opportunity density are highest, and to convert that density into new enterprise relationships. You will report directly to the General Manager of the Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical.

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time.

Net new accounts typically involve mid-level stakeholders across one or two business units and call for a disciplined, transactional approach, matching skills to immediate needs with speed and precision. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units and senior executive relationships.

These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, aligning to evolving client business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level.

Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account, while consistently driving value and long-term growth.
Own and build a portfolio of enterprise Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes.
Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish.
Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning.
Lead solution development and deal execution in partnership with Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, and Delivery teams.
Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature.
Shape industry solutions that apply Toptal ’s technology, marketing, consulting, and AI capabilities to the operating model challenges facing healthcare and life sciences organizations.
Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making.
Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
Your portfolio will ramp over your first 9-12 months, after which you will be measured against an annualized gross sales target of $3.5M, aligning with our broader portfolio strategies.

s.h: In the first week, expect to
s.t:
Onboard with Toptal and meet your TopPal.
Learn the core of Toptal ’s model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities.
Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful.
Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks.
Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes.

s.h: In the first month, expect to
s.t:
Meet key Toptal stakeholders who will support your success and the success of the overall team.
Learn about the Industry Go-To-Market Strategy, our key sales plays, and our client engagement model.
Work with the Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) General Manager to establish a portfolio strategy and build account plans.
Shadow key calls and client meetings.
Begin to meet with clients, leveraging your existing industry network and relationships, to articulate Toptal ’s capabilities and identify where we can help organizations.
Begin prospecting and actively engaging target accounts within your portfolio.
Meet with SDRs, Client Partners, and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategies.
Collaborate with Pursuits and Delivery teams to understand how we design engagements.

s.h: In the first three months, expect to
s.t:

Begin shaping industry solutions that resonate with your target accounts, including AI-enabled approaches, demonstrating your comfort and ability in working with ambiguity and directly working to innovate alongside your clients.
Establish credibility with client stakeholders through informed, consultative engagement tied to their priorities and current initiatives.
Own your pipeline and forecast with confidence.
Develop proposals and close your first set of deals.
Actively contribute to team rituals, best practice sharing, and win/loss reviews.

About Wonderly
Wonderly gives Main Street businesses the AI agents, capital, and growth team they need to scale, and charges nothing for any of it. We only get paid one way: when they make real money.

We own the entire system of record, all business applications (we replace ServiceTitan, House Call Pro, RingCentral, Squarespace, Docusign, Square, and a dozen other applications), and dozens of AI agents ourselves embedded natively inside our business applications, with native data read & write access to our system of record.

As a result, we can deploy dozens of production-ready AI Agents to our customers in under 30 minutes with no FDEs, no integrations, and no data cleaning work.
Wonderly has the most result-driven business model, because we’ve proven our system and AI Agents work. We are not trying to sell our customers a dream - we deliver real revenue and profit to our customers. All of our software and AI Agents are free - we charge a % of revenue we deliver for our customers.

Each of our 10+ core AI Agents help improve their revenue by 5-20%. This is the ultimate outcome-based pricing, only possible when you own the entire end-to-end system and all the agents yourself.
Wonderly already has PMF and has gone from 0 → 1 (we are happy to share more over a call), with very clear moat and deep industry knowledge that took a team of 70 hardcore A-players 18 months of stealth to build. We believe Wonderly has the potential to be a $100B - $1T outcome.

The market is massive: home service businesses across North America (a $2T market). We’ve raised over $50M from top-tier investors, have $20M a year in free cashflow from another product line (Motion) - all that $ gets pumped into Wonderly .
About the Hiring Manager
Hey, I'm Bishop, Head of Customer Experience at Wonderly .
I started in FP&A, realized I wanted to be in the middle of building something instead of analyzing it from the outside, and ended up here.
I'm hiring early-career operators who can sell. People I can put on the phone with a business owner and trust to open the relationship, run the conversation, and move the deal forward. The role I'm hiring for is the role I would have killed for at 22.

You own the top of our funnel. You'll run outbound to service business owners — cold calls, follow-ups, whatever it takes to get them on the phone — pitch the Wonderly model, qualify for fit, and hand the hot ones off (often live) to our team to close.
You're the first human a future customer talks to. The pipeline grows because you make it grow.
This is not a read-from-a-script seat. Our outbound motion is early, and you'll help build the playbook, not inherit a finished one. When something in the process is broken, you flag it and help fix it.
The work is hands-on and high-volume. You'll live on the phone, own your number, keep your pipeline and CRM tight, and feed what you're hearing back into how we target and message. You're not above the grind, and you're not just a dialer either — you think about how to make the whole motion better.
And it's not only calls. We have aggressive growth goals, and hitting them means the outbound engine has to scale — which means digging into your own data, spotting what's working and what isn't, and helping build the systems and process that let us do 10x the volume without falling apart.

You'll analyze your numbers, surface patterns, and help stand up the tooling and playbook that scale us. The best people here don't just hit their number, they help build the machine that makes everyone's number easier to hit.
If you want a defined script and a narrow lane, this isn't it. If you want to carry a number, build the outbound engine with us, and get dramatically better at selling fast, apply.
What Makes This Role Different
Most early-career sales roles are narrow. You join, you run someone else's script, you get good at one motion.
This is the opposite. You're getting in early on the outbound engine of a company that's scaling fast — which means outsized ownership, real influence on the playbook, and a front-row seat to how a company goes from early traction to serious scale. Top performers here move fast into senior sales, team lead, and ops roles.
Backgrounds That Tend to Work

Younergy Solar ist ein Unternehmen für erneuerbare Energien, das Photovoltaik\- und Energielösungen für Unternehmen, öffentliche Institutionen und Privatkunden in der ganzen Schweiz entwickelt und realisiert. Wir verbinden technisches Know\-how mit Lösungen, die für unsere Kund wirtschaftlich sinnvoll sind – von der ersten Analyse bis zur schlüsselfertigen Anlage.
Unser Ziel ist nicht, nur über die Energiewende zu sprechen. Wir setzen sie um – Projekt für Projekt, Dach für Dach.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Wachstums in der Deutschschweiz suchen wir eine erfahrene Vertriebspersönlichkeit mit nachweisbarem Leistungsausweis im B2B\-Verkauf. Bei Younergy Solar akquirierst und berätst Du in erster Linie Unternehmen, Industriebetriebe, Landwirtschaftsbetriebe, Gemeinden und Immobilienverwaltungen in der Deutschschweiz – ergänzt durch punktuelle Privatkundenprojekte.
**Was Du bei uns machst**
Geschäftsentwicklung, aktive Akquise und Kundenberatung stehen im Zentrum Deiner Rolle.
\- Du identifizierst und akquirierst aktiv neue B2B\-Kunden (KMU, Industrie, Landwirtschaft, Gemeinden, Immobilienverwaltungen) in der Deutschschweiz und baust Dir einen eigenen Kundenstamm auf
\- Du berätst zusätzlich B2C\-Kund bei ihren Energiewende\-Projekten, telefonisch, digital und vor Ort
\- Du entwickelst technische und kommerzielle Angebote, die auf die jeweilige Situation zugeschnitten sind, verhandelst diese bis zum Verkaufsabschluss und begleitest das Projekt anschliessend bis zur finalen Abrechnung
\- Du steuerst Deinen Verkaufszyklus eigenständig, von der Lead\-Qualifizierung über die Präsentation bis zur Vertragsunterzeichnung
\- Du baust ein Netzwerk aus relevanten B2B\-Partnern (Installateure, Planer, Verbände) auf und pflegst es aktiv
\- Du koordinierst Dich eng mit unseren Teams aus Technik, Operations, Marketing und Finanzen
\- Du trägst mit eigenen Ideen dazu bei, Prozesse, Angebote und Verkaufstools laufend zu verbessern
\- Du vertrittst Younergy an Messen, Ausstellungen und Fachveranstaltungen in der Deutschschweiz
**Was Du mitbringst**
Wir suchen eine erfahrene Vertriebspersönlichkeit mit nachweisbarem Erfolgsausweis und Netzwerk, kein Berufseinstieg.
\- Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B\-Verkauf mit aktiver Neukundengewinnung, idealerweise im Bereich Photovoltaik, erneuerbare Energien oder technische Anlagen
\- Nachweisbarer Leistungsausweis: erreichte Verkaufsziele, Grösse der betreuten Kundenportfolios oder abgeschlossene Projektvolumen
\- Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Führung komplexer, mehrmonatiger B2B\-Verkaufszyklen – von der Akquise bis zum Vertragsabschluss
\- Technische Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrizität/Energie oder betriebswirtschaftlicher Hintergrund mit ausgeprägter Affinität zu technischen Energielösungen
\- Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools und CRM\-Systemen
\- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und ösisch\- und/oder Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens Niveau B2
\- Strukturierte, selbstständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenmotivation zur Akquise
\- Verhandlungsgeschick, Abschlussstärke und die Fähigkeit, auf Entscheidungsträgerebene (Geschäftsleitung, Gemeinderat) zu überzeugen
\- Regelmässige Reisebereitschaft in die Deutschschweiz
**Was Du von uns bekommst**
\- Ein attraktives Fixgehalt mit leistungsorientiertem, ungedeckeltem Bonus auf Basis Deiner Verkaufsergebnisse
\- Ein Firmenfahrzeug
\- Spannende Aufgaben an der Schnittstelle von neuen Technologien, Energie, Vertrieb und Projektmanagement
\- Viel Freiraum, um Deinen eigenen B2B\-Kundenstamm und Deine Verkaufsansätze aufzubauen
\- Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen
\- Ein multikulturelles Team, das mit Begeisterung ins Büro kommt und Kund besucht
\- Ein Unternehmen, das wächst und in dem Du sichtbar etwas bewegen kannst
\- Die Möglichkeit, die Energiewende in der Schweiz mit konkreten Projekten voranzutreiben
**Interessiert?**
Dann uns Deine Bewerbung. Wir möchten wissen, welche B2B\-Verkaufserfolge Du bisher erzielt hast, wie Du an die Akquise von Energielösungen herangehst und warum Younergy zu Dir passt. Über ein kurzes Video würden wir uns auch freuen.

The Strategic Business Development Advisor is responsible for developing and executing territory and account engagement strategies that expand Galvanize's presence within Enterprise and Government markets.

This role exercises independent judgment in identifying market opportunities, prioritizing target accounts, developing prospect engagement strategies, qualifying business opportunities, and advising internal stakeholders on market trends, customer needs, and pipeline development.

The position collaborates closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, and Strategic Account Advisors to optimize business development initiatives and improve sales effectiveness.

Strategic Pipeline Development
Develop and execute territory-specific prospecting and account engagement strategies aligned with organizational revenue objectives.
Analyze target markets, industry trends, customer initiatives, competitive activity, and organizational priorities to identify high-value business opportunities.
Determine outreach priorities and engagement approaches based on independent assessment of account potential, buying readiness, and strategic fit.
Design and adapt multi-channel engagement strategies utilizing email, phone, LinkedIn, referrals, events, and other approved business development channels.
Evaluate campaign effectiveness and modify outreach strategies to improve engagement and conversion rates.
Business Opportunity Assessment
Conduct consultative discovery conversations to evaluate organizational priorities, workforce challenges, AI initiatives, budget considerations, and strategic objectives.
Exercise independent judgment in determining opportunity qualification, sales readiness, stakeholder alignment, and appropriate next steps.
Identify business risks, obstacles, and competitive considerations while recommending strategies to advance opportunities.
Develop account intelligence and strategic recommendations that enable successful engagement by Strategic Account Advisors.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Serve as a strategic partner to Sales Leadership by providing market intelligence, customer feedback, and recommendations for improving business development effectiveness.
Collaborate with Marketing to refine messaging, campaign strategy, and target audience segmentation.
Recommend improvements to business development processes, sales workflows, qualification methodology, and CRM utilization.
Participate in planning discussions regarding territory development, market expansion, and pipeline forecasting.
Pipeline Management & Business Analysis
Maintain responsibility for the quality, health, and strategic direction of assigned business development pipeline.
Analyze pipeline performance, conversion metrics, and engagement effectiveness to identify trends and recommend corrective actions.
Prepare reports and communicate market observations, business risks, opportunity forecasts, and pipeline insights to leadership.
Ensure CRM records accurately reflect strategic account information, customer needs, opportunity status, and recommended actions.

3+ years of experience in business development, strategic sales, account development, consultative sales, recruiting, or a related client-facing business role.
Demonstrated ability to independently prioritize work, manage territory strategy, and exercise sound business judgment.
Experience analyzing customer organizations and developing strategic engagement plans.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging to executive and senior leadership audiences.
Experience using CRM systems, sales engagement platforms, and business productivity software.
Ability to work independently in a remote environment while managing multiple priorities and competing business objectives.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Experience developing Enterprise or Government accounts.
Knowledge of public-sector procurement, workforce development, professional services, or technology solutions.
Understanding of AI adoption, workforce transformation, and organizational change initiatives.
Experience collaborating across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success functions.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.
We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams
All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page.

Mit über 35'000 stationären und rund 220'000 ambulanten Patient\*innen gehören wir zu den Top 10 der Schweizer Spitäler. Als modernes Zentrumsspital an zwei Standorten decken wir die gesamte Palette der medizinischen Grundversorgung mit 24-Stunden-Notfall und Intensivmedizin ab.
## Interessiert? ##

* Bewerbungsschreiben und separates Motivationsschreiben für HF Pflege Ausbildung und Schwerpunkt
* Lebenslauf und Angabe von 2 Referenzpersonen
* Kompetenzanalyse HF Pflege inkl. Persönlichkeitsprofil
* Selbst- und Fremdbeurteilung HF Eignungspraktikum (wenn bereits vorhanden)
* Alle Zeugnisse (Vor- und Rückseite) der Oberstufe, Berufsschule und eidg. Fähigkeitszeugnis (EFZ)
